† תְּרַע n.[m.] gate, door (𝔗 Syriac; BH שַׁ֫עַר, √ I. שׁער);—cstr. ת׳:
1. door of furnace Dn 3:26.
2. gate of king, i.e. palace, court, Dn 2:49 (cf. Est 2:19, v. שַׁ֫עַר 3 a; also Arabic بَابٌ gate, then الباب the court of a sovereign; pl. الابواب Sublime Porte, of Turkish court, v. especially Dozy i. 124).
